title: Alaska Airlines: Air Travel Consumer Report: Full Year 2024
summary: DOT Table 6C reports 2024 and 2023 scheduled operations, cancellations, and cancellation rates for reporting operating carriers. Phase 56E entity use: The annual series is published with the October 2025 Alaska-Hawaiian single-certificate break attached.
key_findings: The record supplies a common annual cancellation denominator for American, Alaska, and JetBlue.
Entity layer: Alaska Airlines operating-carrier domestic scheduled service.
Compatibility boundary: The carrier name continues, but the operating population changes after the single certificate.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: Operating-carrier rows are not marketing-network results and do not normalize route, weather, airport, or schedule mix.
Official DOT compilation with the identity break explicitly disclosed.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
